viber-revanced.description: Viber ReVanced is a patched version of the official Viber Messenger app (package com.viber.voip) using ReVanced tools. It applies official patches including Hide ads (removes in-app advertisements and sponsored content) and Hide navigation buttons (customizes or hides bottom navigation elements for a cleaner UI). These are the confirmed, correct patches available in the official revanced-patches repository—no premium unlock (such as unlimited stickers, advanced privacy extras, or Viber Out credits) exists, as such features are server-side or not targeted by patches. Additional community requests for broader changes (e.g., telemetry removal, spam blocking) remain unaddressed in official patches.
